svg.aria-label: How morning-fairy works: at 08:00 on a weekday the fairy visits each connected tool (calendar, email, meeting notes, Slack, Jira, GitHub, cloud spend, Claude sessions, Tempo, the web), builds one page, and a to-do you tick opens Claude in its project with its context
svg.title: How morning-fairy works

g.text: 08:00 on a weekday, the scheduled run wakes the fairy
she visits every tool you connected, once
everything she found becomes one page
tick a to-do, and Claude starts on it with its context
reads every tool you connect, builds one page, hands your pick to Claude
